Building the infrastructure for domestic production

America doesn't have a shortage of demand for food. It has a shortage of people available to produce it. Physical AI can give food manufacturers the productive capacity to grow domestically rather than sending production elsewhere.

Traditional automation wasn’t built for the complexity of food
‍

Many of our customers have tried traditional automation (multi-head dispensers, vibratory feeders, and volumetric fill dispensers) before turning to Chef.

These systems struggle with the natural variability of food ingredients, frequent changeovers, and high-mix production, leaving companies no choice but to rely on manual labor.

We believe this work shouldn’t have to be done by hand.

Physical AI makes robots intelligent enough to handle food

ChefOS, our physical AI operating system, enables Chef robots to manipulate real food in all its natural variability.

Chef’s robotic module C-001748 is NSF-certified

Chef’s robotic module C-001748 is certified under “NSF/ANSI 169 – Special Purpose Food Equipment and Devices,” a standard for commercial food equipment. This certification confirms that the robot meets strict requirements for food safety and cleanability.

RaaS includes:

Core hardware and software
